capabilities: Clone, fetch, and push a GitHub wiki repository
Authenticate via GitHub OAuth device flow or a personal access token
Sync on demand, at startup, on file change, or on a periodic timer
Map a vault folder's top-level files to wiki pages
extras: README documents outbound network behavior and states no telemetry is collected; the wiki repo must already have at least one page created via the GitHub web UI; mobile is supported but dev symlinks are not; includes local development setup instructions.
problem: GitHub wikis can only be edited through the GitHub web interface or with git tooling, not directly from a Markdown editor like Obsidian.

requires.name: personal access token (alternative to OAuth sign-in)

summary: GitHub Wiki sync plugin that stores a vault in, or edits existing pages of, a GitHub wiki repository.
